description.short_caption: Pustule on the fourth finger of the left hand.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the palmar aspect of a left hand with a small pustule located on the fourth finger near the proximal interphalangeal joint. The pustule appears as a raised, round lesion with a whitish center, consistent with localized inflammation or infection. The surrounding skin shows no significant erythema or swelling. The background is a green medical drape, suggesting a clinical setting.
